title: Ransomware incidents in Japan in the first half of 2026: Investigation of The Gentlemens infrastructure and evidence of Qilin's AI use

verified_facts: 1 MITRE ATT&CK technique(s) evidenced in the source material.

analyst_assessments.text: Activity is consistent with a ransomware operation — data encryption and/or recovery inhibition (shadow-copy deletion) was observed.
Any actor attribution derives from historical TTP/infrastructure overlap and requires corroboration before operational use.

intelligence_gaps: No confirmed public IOCs are available at report time; detection currently relies on behavioral analytics.
No authoritative CVSS score is available at report time.
In-the-wild exploitation is unconfirmed as of this report.

forward_outlook.text: Double-extortion and data-leak-site activity is anticipated to accompany encryption events.

correlations: Malware Qilin has been correlated with prior TTP use: T1486
Technique T1486 was previously observed with: Qilin, LockBit, Cl0p, ALPHV/BlackCat, Akira
